RS Praveen Kumar alleges scam, claims security cover reduced

RS Praveen Kumar has alleged a scam amounting to Rs 2,041 crore related to supplies in residential schools. He also stated that his security cover was reduced after he exposed alleged scams. The BRS party has accused the Congress government of acting out of vendetta.
